Artificial intelligence is creating opportunities far beyond chatbots and software applications.

A striking example emerged this week when Etched, a San Jose-based AI chip startup, raised $700 million, taking its valuation to approximately $21 billion more than double its valuation less than a month earlier.

The post that reached the most people wasn't the post people talked about.

I ranked four weeks of LinkedIn analytics and last month's Shashi.co traffic the same way, by reach and by reaction. The winners didn't match.

It was the same pattern on both places.

 A post on exposure management for CISOs reached 24,394 impressions and 78 engagements.

A post about being named a Distinguished Analyst for 2027 pulled 1,191 engagements on 6,211 impressions. 

A quarter the reach, fifteen times the interaction.

- Agentic AI in enterprise work management
